source_lines: candidates = [int(v) for v in np.unique(grid) if int(v) != background and int(v) != marker]
color = max(candidates, key=lambda v: np.count_nonzero(grid == v))
rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if np.all(row == color)]
columns = [i for i, column in enumerate(grid.T) if np.all(column == color)]
rationale: Count the gray marker cells. Remove them and shift the cross's horizontal line downward and vertical line leftward by that count, preserving its color and the grid dimensions.
